hooks.prompt:
You are about to edit or create a file. You MUST perform a Risk Assessment BEFORE proceeding.

State the following inline RIGHT NOW before making any changes:

🔍 Risk Assessment: 🟢 LOW / 🟡 MEDIUM / 🔴 HIGH
Reason: <why this risk level — what specifically is being changed>
Affected: <file(s) and which tools/features they impact>
Dependencies: <other files/services that may be affected>
Breaking: <yes/no — are any existing tool names, required params, or APIs being changed>

Risk level guide:
🟢 LOW    — Docs, comments, README, non-functional text
🟡 MEDIUM — Logic change in one tool/skill, new optional param, new file with no existing impact
🔴 HIGH   — MCP tool signature change, shared service (jira-client/config-manager/memory-manager), index.js, SkillRegistry.js, package.json deps, install/setup scripts

Do NOT proceed with the edit until the risk assessment is shown.

A file was just edited or created. You MUST now provide the full Impact Summary:

## 📋 Change Summary
**What changed:** <one-line description>
**Files modified:** <list>
**Risk level:** 🟢/🟡/🔴

### Impact
- What behaviour changed and why
- What stays the same
- Side effects on other tools or files

### How to Test
#### Automated
- [ ] npm run validate
- [ ] npm test
- [ ] <specific command for changed area>

#### Manual (in Claude CLI)
- [ ] <exact phrase to trigger the changed tool>
- [ ] <what to verify in the response>
- [ ] <edge case to check>

### Test Cases
| # | Input | Expected Output | Pass? |
|---|-------|----------------|-------|
| 1 | <happy path> | <expected> | ☐ |
| 2 | <edge case> | <expected> | ☐ |
| 3 | <failure case> | <error/fallback> | ☐ |

Then ask: "Would you like me to save this summary to README / TESTING.md, or keep it here? And shall I commit these changes?"

NEVER commit without explicit developer confirmation.
